fusions.name: Dabbled Lob
fusions.desc: Flings a scrap of weed that deals 4 damage and has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swiped Purse
fusions.desc: A quick peck that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Nimble Paddling
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fiddled Knot
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
